decisions.reason: The 70×50 mm resize and ESP32 edge placement apply to the main board; the sensor board's dimensions and mechanical constraints remain unchanged.
The source changes the main-board outline and ESP32 placement, not the power-board dimensions or layout.
The source does not change the battery connector's power-board placement, orientation, clearance, or spacing.
Accepting physical placement of the ESP32 on the PCB edge does not change the selected module or unused-pin breakout requirements.
The main-board resize and connector-layout decision does not change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, or cable-length requirements.
The mechanical-layout decision does not affect DCDC1 voltage configuration or the required 3.3V regulation behavior.
The client rejects a freelancer proposal to consolidate connectors, so the already-current set of separate JST interboard connectors remains valid without modification.
The source does not change BOOT or reset circuit behavior, connections, or capacitance.
ESP32 edge placement and board resizing do not alter any GPIO assignment or compatibility constraint.
The source does not change monitored rails, monitoring channels, current-monitor placement, or measurement coverage.
The main-board mechanical changes do not alter standalone USB supply capacity, activation, powered load, or source selection.
The source does not change USB-C programming or native USB behavior.
